description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

Allows legacy roaming for credentials and tokens created by the Web Account Manager (WAM) system. Some Microsoft 365 applications may require authentication at every sign-in when disabled.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\RoamIdentity
Type: DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled
